<!--
Please write in English or Chinese. / 请使用英文或中文填写。

Keep the default sections concise. Draft or specialized PRs may adapt the
structure when it improves review clarity, while preserving equivalent coverage
of the change, validation, and scope.

请保持默认结构简洁。Draft 或特殊类型的 PR 可以在有助于 Review 的情况下调整结构，
但应保留对变更内容、验证结果和范围边界的等价说明。
-->

## Summary / 摘要

<!--
What problem or goal does this PR address, and what is the resulting behavior?
Link relevant issues when applicable: Closes #123 / Related to #123.

这个 PR 解决什么问题或目标？最终行为发生了什么变化？
如有相关 Issue，请在适用时关联：Closes #123 / Related to #123。
-->

## What changed / 变更内容

<!--
Summarize the important behavioral or implementation changes. Group by responsibility; avoid a file-by-file changelog.

概括重要的行为或实现变化。按职责组织内容，避免逐文件罗列 changelog。
-->

## Validation / 验证

<!--
List checks actually performed and their results. Call out material limitations,
manual/environment-specific verification, and anything not tested. For user-visible
UI changes, include screenshots or a short recording when useful.

列出实际执行的检查及结果。说明重要限制、手动或特定环境验证，以及未测试的内容。
如果包含用户可见的 UI 变化，在有帮助时附上截图或短录屏。
-->

## Scope control / 范围控制

<!--
State meaningful non-goals, preserved behavior, compatibility constraints, safety boundaries, or intentionally deferred work.

说明重要的非目标、保持不变的行为、兼容性约束、安全边界或有意延后的工作。
-->
